items.description: One day bucket of the acknowledgement & translation report.

dayBucket.description: The UTC day this row summarizes (RFC3339, midnight).

ordersRejectedUntranslatableSku.description: Rejected because the Anti-Corruption Layer had no SKU mapping for one or more lines — a catalogue gap, not a business refusal.

ordersRejectedDomain.description: Rejected because order-management's promise policy could not meet the network's requiredShipBy.

acknowledgementDeadlinesMissed.description: The 24-hour acknowledgement window closed with no answer ever sent (the sweep's own rejection). An operational failure, not a business decision.

ordersRejectedSubmissionFailed.description: Rejected with reason `SUBMISSION_FAILED`: we submitted an acknowledgement, but the network's own transaction-status reconciliation reported failure, so the order was refused. Not a catalogue gap or a promise refusal: we said yes and the network did not accept it. Added additively (ADR 0015); history before this counter existed reads 0.

avgAcknowledgementLatencySeconds.description: Average seconds between an order's receipt and its acknowledgement, over the orders acknowledged in this bucket. Zero when none were acknowledged in the bucket (never NaN).
